audit_items.proof_trace: Cross-sale replay is prevented because every sale contract is deployed as a unique clone (factory uses `.clone()`), binding the signature to an irrecoverable `address(this)`. Post-sale replay is prevented by the `whenSaleNotEnded` modifier, which enforces `block.timestamp < s_saleConfig.endTime` and reverts otherwise. Within-sale repeated use of the same signature is intentional — the whitelist-model sales (FixedPrice, SealedBid, PreLiquidOpen) accumulate `investedCapital` across calls by design, unlike `LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale` which issues per-transaction signatures with unique parameters.
